warmup.description: Gradually elevate heart rate and ease into a steady aerobic rhythm.
movements: Easy walk or cycle x 3 minutes

main_exercises.name: Zone 2 Steady State Cardio
main_exercises.load_guidance: Maintain intensity zone 2 (around 60-70% effort), where you can hold a conversation comfortably
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep breathing steady and rhythmic, ideally through the nose or controlled nasal inhale

cooldown.description: Gradually bring heart rate down and transition into recovery.
movements: Slow walk or easy cycle x 3 minutes
Deep breathing while standing or seated x 2 minutes

phase_notes.menstrual: This gentle zone 2 session can support circulation and reduce fatigue—keep pace very comfortable and adjust intensity based on energy levels.
phase_notes.follicular: You may find it easier to maintain a steady rhythm—use this session to build aerobic consistency without pushing intensity.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Even with higher energy, keep this session truly in zone 2—focus on control and sustainability rather than speeding up.
phase_notes.early_luteal: This is a great phase to maintain steady cardio habits—focus on smooth pacing and consistent breathing.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session can help manage stress and fatigue—keep intensity low and prioritize a calming, steady rhythm.
